gazetteer.title: DEEP: the English Place-Name Society survey (county volume Dorset)
gazetteer.description: Place-centric PLATO serialisation of the DEEP MADS XML (Jisc, 2017 release; mirrored 2026-09-26), county volume Dorset. Generated and schema-validated against PLATO v0.5.0 (release 0.5.0, commit fa0d247ccc0263f8f19c8d7cdcd163df96935d1e). Identifiers are https://w3id.org/whg-epns/<county>/<serial>, carrying DEEP's own 2013 numbering, registered at w3id.org by the World Historical Gazetteer. This is release data-2026-09-28, a frozen snapshot of the living gazetteer https://w3id.org/whg-epns/: it is never regenerated in place. Data: English Place-Name Society, digitised by DEEP, published by Jisc. Conversion: Stephen Gadd (github.com/WorldHistoricalGazetteer/epns). Licence: Digitisation of English Placenames MADS data is licensed to Jisc by the English Place Names Society and released under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License. This serialisation is an adaptation and carries the same terms. plato_commit=fa0d247ccc0263f8f19c8d7cdcd163df96935d1e
